name: spendctl
description: Pay through the spendctl sidecar you run: every paid HTTP call (x402, MPP) is checked against your policy, held for approval above your thresholds, and written to the ledger. Tools: pay, check_budget, list_receipts.

agent.title: Agent name
agent.description: The agent this Claude Code session pays as, exactly as defined under `agents:` in your spendctl.yaml (the init template defines `researcher`).

sidecar_url.title: Sidecar URL
sidecar_url.description: Where `spendctl start` is listening. Leave the default unless you changed server.host or server.port.
